analysis: Reviewed the base and head excerpts of provider-swift/Tests/DarkbloomCLITests/SandboxSetupTests.swift. The visible changes are test-only: SandboxSetupFlow constructions in tests now pass `waitlist: .approved` (changed lines 539, 550, 669, 813, 835, 866, 901, 934, 967, 1026, 1053, 1072, 1085, 1100). No production code is in this unit, so no change to trust boundaries, attestation, encryption, or authorization appears here. The tests exercise the TB-013/T-061 controls: an https-only installer URL (userinfo, query and fragment refused), a 1 MiB cap checked before the body is read, a shell-script shebang requirement, and a 0700 directory with 0600 script permissions for the staged file. They also exercise the confirmation gate (no install without --yes or an interactive yes) and the pre-install eligibility checks. The tests do not weaken those checks. One thing I could not confirm: the new `waitlist` parameter on SandboxSetupFlow is defined in a production file that is not in this batch. Its default value and semantics, and whether `.approved` bypasses or changes any gating (waitlist or approval) in production, need review there. The head excerpt is truncated at line 460 and the patch excerpt is incomplete, so the rest of the file is unseen. T-041 was supplied as context but is not relevant to this change.
